ruleDefinitions.name: All Rules Have Been Deleted From The Windows Firewall Configuration
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a all the rules have been deleted from the Windows Defender Firewall configuration Note: Unmapped fields: ModifyingApplication

sequences.query: (event_id = 2033 OR event_id = 2059) AND  NOT (ModifyingApplication = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\svchost\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((ModifyingApplication = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Platform\\\\.*") AND ModifyingApplication = RGX(".*\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe.*")))
